subject: maths
question: One boy and one girl together can complete a piece of work in 4 days. One boy alone can complete the work in 5 days. In how many days can one girl alone complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

One boy and one girl together can complete the work in 4 days.

One boy alone can complete the work in 5 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

LCM method for Time and Work:

Total Work = LCM of individual times.

Efficiency = Total Work / Time.

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of their times, i.e., LCM(4, 5) = 20 units.

Efficiency of one boy and one girl together = Total Work / Time = 20 / 4 = 5 units/day.

Efficiency of one boy alone = Total Work / Time = 20 / 5 = 4 units/day.

Efficiency of one girl alone = Efficiency of boy and girl together - Efficiency of boy = 5 - 4 = 1 unit/day.

Time taken by one girl alone = Total Work / Efficiency = 20 / 1.

⇒ Time = 20 days.

**One girl alone can complete the work in 20 days.**
